data.define: To study many things quickly just before a test.

misuse.why: Cramming only works for short tests.

data.l1_hook: Prova amanhã. Ainda não estudei! Preciso "cram".

native.tip: “cram” = estudar de última hora. Exemplo: “I must cram for math.”
native.caption:
